Off the Books: Stacking 1.12.0
RnK Gaming

WHAT IT DOES
Lets materials, medical items and key cards stack in one inventory slot, with a
stack limit for each kind of goods. A stack is valued, sold and used by its count.
It works alone. If Station Economy is running, Station Economy does the stacking
and this mod adds places and limits to it. If Faucet Filter is also installed,
a stack dropped on its faucet loses one unit.
Do not run it beside another mod that stacks items, such as Item Stacks.
Restart after you change which mods are enabled.

HOW TO USE IT
Drop matching items on each other. They also merge when the game puts an item
in an inventory that has a matching stack with room.
Scroll while dragging to change how many units you hold, and split those off.
Only matching goods merge: name, value, labels and other properties must match.
Clean and stolen goods stay apart. Different heat or purity stay apart. Kotton
Fabric needs the same wear. Both items must be yours. Bought prices may differ;
the stack keeps the price of the item it joins.
The game's number shows how many units a stack holds. Its value, and the price a
customer pays, is for the whole stack.
Using a stack uses one unit. A machine takes the units one by one while it
accepts them. A lock takes one key card. Bandages and other medicine used at once
use one unit. Split a stack before you unpack or activate an item that is not
used up at once. Junk on a reactor lowers its maximum integrity by 5 for each
repair, as separate pieces do.
A stack of metal or electronic parts dropped on something the first part replaces,
such as a corrupted module, uses one part; drop again for the next one.
Marketplace requests and barters take only the units they ask for and leave the
rest of the stack. A customer who wants variety takes one unit of a stack.

WHAT STACKS
On its own the mod stacks these goods:
Materials: Metal Ingot, Scrap Metal, Junk, Kotton Fabric, Metal Ore, Rare Metal
Ore, Electronic Parts (Common, Rare, Hypertech), Wire, Printer Plastic, Gun
Parts, Metal Screws, Chemical Supplies and Medical Supplies (Common, Restricted).
Medical: the three bandages, Tilapia Skin Graft, pills, dusts, injectors, salve,
rubbing alcohol, blood bags, smelling salt, ZeroChew and the surgery toolset.
Key cards.
Any other item whose count is above one is also valued, sold and used as a
stack, unless it is unsafe to stack.
With Station Economy running, its own item list and rules apply instead.

WHERE
The shop grid, the back room, both counters and the after-hours inventory.
Your Storage Bays, including the Makeshift, Gunsmith, Chemist and Hypertech bays.
Your Smuggler's Bays, Machine Bays and engineering, medical, security, service
and evidence crates.
Your backpacks. By default a backpack needs its stacking upgrade.
Machines, single-item slots and the trash can hold one unit.
Shop Expansion's separate shelves are not covered.

SETTINGS
All switches are on unless the text says otherwise.
Stacking enabled: turns off new stacking and this mod's limits. Existing stacks
keep their value and can still be split and used.
Smuggler's bays, Machine bays, Loot crates, Backpacks: allow stacks in those places.
Backpack stacking needs its upgrade: a backpack needs its stack size upgrade before
it accepts stacks. This mod does not provide the upgrade; Off the Books: Backpacks
does. Switch this off to stack in any backpack you own.
Requests take units from stacks: a request takes only the units it asks for.
Barters take units from stacks: a barter takes one unit for each thing it asks for.
This covers the trash can and customer offers with conditions. Rewards and offers
without conditions work as in the base game.
Refuse stacks when units are not taken: when a setting above is off or cannot be
used, a stack is refused for that request or barter. Off, the game may take a
whole stack for one item.
A customer who wants variety takes one unit of a stack: one unit stays on the counter
and the rest goes to the shop's storage. What does not fit stays in the stack and
is sold with it. If a split cannot be checked safely, the stack is sold whole.
Look past a stated wear that equals the real wear: items of equal wear stack when a
seller's stated wear matches the real wear or is missing. This includes empty filters.
Stack limit: access cards, and one setting for each other kind of goods: the most
units one stack may hold, from 1 to 99. The defaults are access cards 10, ammunition
50, medical 10, food 10, household goods 10, substances 10, materials 20 and other
items 5. An item with several kinds uses the first in that order. A limit does not
add item kinds to the list of what stacks. Lowering a limit leaves existing stacks
as they are; a full stack accepts no more.
Maximum in a backpack: 5, from 1 to 5. A backpack uses the smaller of this and the
category limit. With the upgrade requirement on, its upgrade level also caps it:
two at level 1, up to five at level 4.
Extra items and Excluded items: empty. Lists of item identifiers, separated by
commas, for example cat_bar. Extra items stack as well; Excluded items form no new
stacks and take no more units. Only the mod's own stacking uses these lists, not
Station Economy's. Glass Shards, containers, items with contents and items with
durability (Kotton Fabric excepted) are refused. Extra items have not been checked
against every use the game or other mods have for them; start with a copy of your
save.

Settings that apply only with Station Economy doing the stacking:
Stack goods from different sellers: Probably a Farm Story marks goods with the visit
they came in. With this on, that mark no longer keeps equal goods apart.
Stack goods with a mark that is switched off: the game leaves some marks on goods
after switching them off (stolen on goods too cheap to count, challenged after you
bought them, water or household good on a bottle). With this on they no longer keep
equal goods apart. Goods that really are stolen stay apart.
Stack empty bottles: empty liquid containers of one kind stack, whatever they held.
A container with anything in it is compared as before.
Look past a lock mark that is switched off: goods that were in a locked container
stack with equal goods once it is unlocked. Goods behind a lock now stay apart.
An item split off a stack keeps its types: a genuine cigarette pack taken off a stack
gets back its Luxury Item type when it meets a pack that kept it.
Stack goods ordered by phone with the same goods from elsewhere: the joined stack
keeps the marks of the stack that took the others in. Station Economy pays no
premium at a tender for goods with the phone-order mark.
The rest of a used stack is never lost: when one unit of a stack is used, for
example a jug filled from a stack of empty jugs, the others go back as a new stack.
If neither the place of the stack nor the back inventory has room, this setting puts
them in the main inventory, the back inventory or on the back counter, wherever
there is room. If nothing has room they stay on the stack itself.
Faucet Filter: a dropped stack gives one unit: a stack dropped on Faucet Filter's
faucet loses one unit and keeps the rest. A single item is destroyed as usual. The
mod's own stacking has the same guard. It connects only if Faucet Filter is present
when the game starts.

WITH STATION ECONOMY
Its item list, comparison, display and use rules apply, and this mod's own stacking
is inactive, even if Station Economy's stacking is switched off. This mod adds
Smuggler's Bays, Machine Bays, the five crates and upgraded backpacks as places,
and its category and backpack limits only lower what Station Economy allows.
Station Economy's automatic shop sweep can still merge past the category limits;
this mod keeps that sweep out of the places it adds. Items with their own stacking
rule, from another mod, are left to that mod. If Station Economy is laid out in a
way this mod cannot read, this mod stays inactive.

WHAT IT CHANGES IN YOUR SAVE
It adds no data of its own. A stack is an item with a count above one, and that
count is saved. Stacks made by Item Stacks keep working. The mod has its own
settings; settings of Item Stacks are not carried over.

REMOVING IT
Split every stack into single items, save, then switch the mod off or remove it.
Without a stacking mod, saved stacks keep their count but the game values and
uses a stack as one item. That can lose goods. With Station Economy still running,
its rules continue to apply; move stacks out of the places this mod added first.


PLAYER.LOG
Every line starts with [Stacking]. After a game loads, one line says which stacking
is used: the mod's own, or Station Economy's. "connected to Station Economy's
stacking" confirms the connection. Each fault is reported once. "the rest of a used
stack found no room" is written for the first 20 cases only. If the game's code is
not as expected, the mod stays inactive and says so once.

TRANSLATIONS
Translations are very welcome: every text is in Localization/en.csv. Send a translated
copy on GitHub: https://github.com/rnk-gaming/probably-stolen-mods/issues
